title: Volta Plant Floor
description: Volta Plant Floor — a high-utilization run ~3 weeks ago wore ~90 production lines toward failure (rising vibration/temperature, open corrective work orders, parts that would need expediting). ~$3.5M downtime-at-risk exposure at ~$22K/hr. Ask which lines are trending to a stop and whether to pull now, run to shift end, or expedite the part — LINE-0004 (PLANT-03) is the hero.
